opening.argument: The video presents a recorded call for examination, including a purported company owner and the promise that the call will be released for the audience. Within that recording, the caller directs the computer user to approve software, states that the mouse is moving remotely, discusses a one-time activation cost, and requests completion of a registration form. Those scam-like requests are attributed to the recorded caller, while the video's own audience-facing purpose is commentary and release of the call, not an offer to sell the depicted service or obtain viewers' card information. The displayed amount is discussed, but the evidence does not establish that any payment was completed.
